implementation_note.multiplier_derivation: one multiplicative repetition per variable; exactly 256 deterministic nonzero GF(1024) multipliers derived independently from a SHA256 domain separated from the mother coefficients: 1 + SHA256(ASCII('NBLDPC7R1B|mult|{seed}|{col}')) % 1023 with frozen multiplier_seed 2026080401 (a one-time acceptance choice, never re-searched at runtime). multiplier_spec_id = SHA256 of {multiplier_seed, derivation, count, multipliers}. The repeated observation is z_v = mult_v * x_v XOR e'_v with an independent q-ary-symmetric error.
implementation_note.prior_combining_formula: the repeated evidence is aligned by the inverse multiplier a_v = inv(mult_v) * z_v (a bijection: fixed nonzero multiplication permutes the nonzero field elements, so a_v has the same q-ary symmetric noise p), then combined INTO the variable prior exactly as the brute-force posterior product of two independent QSC observations: P(x_v=s) prop QSC_p(b_v,s) * QSC_p(a_v,s), normalized per variable. No second dense Tanner graph exists; the combined prior is then decoded by the ACCEPTED R1A flooding/layered FFT-QSPA core (v7_long._decode_flooding/_decode_layered invoked directly; check_update_fft_qspa is the accepted R1A function by identity).
implementation_note.decoder_contract: flooding FFT-QSPA is the literature-reference schedule and the primary production decoder (production_runner); layered FFT-QSPA is a frozen same-code diagnostic. Both deterministic (workers=1), max_iter=100, damping lambda=.75 (layered only; flooding undamped), exact whole-graph syndrome check after every iteration, fail-closed on NaN/Inf/non-finite/wrong length/malformed syndrome/allocation breach, no fallback between schedules. The public signature (bob_symbols, repeated_symbols, syndrome, manifest, matrices, check_count, p, schedule, max_iter) contains no Alice truth or callback.

implementation_note.disclosure_accounting: the same mother syndrome 10*m = 1700 bits per frame plus an invoked 64-bit Toeplitz tag; R1B is the final repetition depth (a second repetition would exceed the frozen 8.75-bit/symbol key-dependent disclosure ceiling). Public control: multiplier identities recorded as control-plane data, 256*10 = 2560 public_control_bits, plus the verification seed bits (n*10+63 = 2623) and 2 decision bits.
